defects.title: Missing theme toggle button in header
defects.expected: Locked decision A2 requires: 'The header holds the logo (left), the nav, and a theme toggle button at the right end: <button id="theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle theme"> at least 44x44px that switches html[data-theme] between dark and light.'
defects.actual: Header only contains the logo link and the three navigation links ('Shop', 'Story', 'Contact'). The theme toggle button element is completely missing across all viewports.

history.result: verify: CO-001 FAIL (designer PASS, frontend PARTIAL, checks 3P/0F/0E)
history.cause: reviewers disagree after sync (designer PASS, frontend PARTIAL)

history.result: verify: CO-007 PASS (designer PASS, frontend PASS, checks 3P/0F/0E)

defects.title: Horizontal overflow and scrolling on mobile viewport (375px)
defects.expected: Locked decision A3 requires: 'Mobile first: no horizontal scrolling at 375, 768 or 1280 px. Every block fits the viewport width; content max-width 1100px.'
defects.actual: On the 375px viewport (S-001), horizontal scrolling occurs with scrollWidth=660px against clientWidth=375px (overflowPx=285), caused by an inflexible fixed-width promo strip.

history.result: verify: CO-002 PASS (designer PASS, frontend PASS, checks 1P/0F/0E)

defects.title: Hero subtitle rendered in forbidden all-caps text
evidence: S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontSize=36px
defects.expected: Locked decision A1 requires: 'Sentence case everywhere: NO all-caps text — text-transform: uppercase is forbidden on every element.'
defects.actual: The hero subtitle paragraph below h1 is rendered entirely in uppercase ('HAND-THROWN MUGS, LINEN AND SMALL-BATCH COFFEE FROM DAR ES SALAAM.').

history.result: verify: CO-003 PASS (designer PASS, frontend PASS, checks 1P/0F/0E)

defects.title: Header container is unconstrained by max-width 1100px on desktop
defects.expected: A3 locked decision mandates: 'content max-width 1100px' across blocks to keep content aligned.
defects.actual: On desktop 1280px, <header> width is 1280px and stretches logo to x=20 and nav to x=1260, whereas <main> is centered at max-width 1100px (x=90 to x=1190), resulting in visual misalignment between header items and main content.

history.result: verify: CO-004 PASS (designer PASS, frontend PASS, checks 1P/0F/0E)

defects.title: Theme toggle button icon has insufficient contrast in dark theme
defects.expected: Theme toggle button content should use text color #E5E7EB or accent #F2F0EB to ensure legible contrast (>=4.5:1) against dark background #0B0C10 per decision A4
defects.actual: Button content color is unstyled black rgb(0, 0, 0) against rgb(11, 12, 16) resulting in contrastRatio=1.07 (LOW-CONTRAST), rendering the icon inside virtually invisible

history.result: verify: CO-007 PASS (designer PASS, frontend PASS, checks 3P/0F/0E)

defects.title: Theme toggle button content has near-zero contrast against dark header background
defects.expected: Theme toggle button text/icon should use text color #E5E7EB or accent #F2F0EB per Decision A4, meeting WCAG AA contrast >= 3:1 against #0B0C10.
defects.actual: color is rgb(0, 0, 0) on backgroundColor rgb(11, 12, 16), producing contrastRatio=1.07 (LOW-CONTRAST) which makes the toggle icon/content invisible.

history.result: verify: CO-007 PASS (designer PASS, frontend PASS, checks 3P/0F/0E)

defects.title: CO-001: frontend sees a problem although its checks passed
defects.expected: Add <button id="theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle theme" type="button"> inside the header that switches html[data-theme] between dark and light. Ensure the toggle button and all header nav links have touch targets of at least 44x44px. — and a NEW check that measures what the reviewer saw
defects.actual: frontend PARTIAL: #theme-toggle button exists in the header with 44x44px touch target. Nav links meet the >=44x44px touch target (Shop 51.78x44, Story 51.47x44, Contact 69.67x44).
